title: tolpis barbata
intro: Tolpis barbata, commonly known as Barren Strawberry or Woolly Hair, is a perennial herb in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues and inflammation, due to its soothing effects on the body. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tolpis barbata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
